fairness.equivalence: A full DCT basis spans every temporal kernel, so bands=full is an orthonormal reparameterization of a post-squash TXC with k_pos*T shared activations per window.
fairness.purpose: Full-band global-top-k monolithic control for the multiband spectral models.
fairness.reporting: Compare parameter count, realized l0_per_window, NMSE, and paired recovery to the main benchmark's TXC-pre and multiband spectral-v1 rows.
